_about: A clean comparison in the user's city '123' (read-only: loaded, never saved). The save was outgrown by an older build (gardens over streets, empty ones), so every garden is first planned again with this build (polishSettings {}: Redo, polishIdle: how long the whole city takes) and checked (outgrowCheck A). Then, from that same state: 45 s paused (the baseline frames), 45 s running with level-ups planned (as it ships), check B, 45 s running with level-ups kept (no plan; close-ups of four), check C. Compare frames against the paused stretch of this run, and the checks as differences A->B and B->C (open fence, hidden fence, bare lawn, gardens over roads), per level-up planned or kept.
